scope: Analysis of two already completed failed food poster candidates, without generating/altering any image

first.filename: 辣椒炒肉_家常小炒盛宴.png
first.human_feedback: 现在有点设计感了。但是远远不够

actual_image_check.environment: Original candidate PNGs read from mounted task artifact paths /mnt/data; sha256 recomputed from file bytes, Pillow RGB decoded and resized for metric
actual_image_check.resizing_note: Both images have same 1122x1402 dimensions; resized each to exactly 500x625 using PIL default RGB resizing
actual_image_check.metric: grayscale structural similarity index (SSIM) measured with skimage.metrics.structural_similarity(data_range=1) and skimage.color.rgb2gray
actual_image_check.limitation: Low SSIM means large pixel-level change, not design superiority or semantic diversity. Region comparisons are defined by fixed rectangles on normalized 500x625 and are not content-aligned. The next observation is a separate visual judgement.

human_look.first: Large title upper-left, rice bowl upper-right, cooked dish dominant lower-middle, chopsticks lower-right on neutral table
human_look.second: Larger upper-left heading with red curving accent and small red mark; rice bowl upper-right, cooked dish dominant lower-middle/left, chopsticks lower-right, linen added beneath dish

visual_mechanism_judgment.failure: The renderer changes output pixels and typography accents, but retains the same interchangeable four-object food-poster schema.
visual_mechanism_judgment.distinction: This is an expert visual inference from two displayed results, not a machine-proven compositional classification. User strongly rejected the second result; original accepted food photo remains protected.

independent_primary_source_crosscheck.supported_observation: The team reports that polishing logos earlier and then showing rough logo sketches both failed to solve the wrong decision order; they use cohesive visual-direction boards before detailed identity
The brand's 15-degree tilt is explicitly connected to movement and reused in logo, graphics, typography, and layouts, rather than added as an arbitrary decorative slash
Cast-iron skillet selected because the restaurant needed to stand apart from the meat-first barbecue stereotype while honoring home-style side dishes
Top-down food photography chosen to support a frequently changing seasonal menu with one dish per page, not simply because top-down photos look premium

reasoned_application.core_mismatch: Our poster had no confirmed brand/placement-specific visual proposition; rice bowl, chopsticks and ceramic plate would work with almost any stir-fry. Strong adjectives cannot supply the absent relationship.
remaining_unknowns: How much of poor visual output comes from model capability vs direction selection
Which exact visual direction the user would accept in a future authorized experiment
Whether the same product photo can support a distinctive campaign without additional genuine product/brand evidence
avoid: Treating SSIM as a quality score
Claiming a specific design method has been validated by this audit
Creating new candidate art or a restyled render despite explicit user stop
reasoned_application.right_next_decision: The project needs a real business/usage-specific art direction to be selected before any new commercial-quality image can be meaningfully evaluated; until explicit new user authorization, preserve stop and do not spend visual generation budget.

completed: Computed actual dimensions/hashes and normalized pixel difference of both existing images; separated pixel change from recurring scene composition and cross-checked against primary studio accounts
incomplete: No human-accepted high-design poster or validated reusable art-direction mechanism
next_required_action: Maintain STOP. Do not produce or edit posters, or fill time with new research artifacts. Resume only upon explicit new user request naming a fresh task or lifting the stop.
